loc.store_introtext:
Hello, little boy and/or girl! I'm Saxton Hale, CEO of Mann Co.--the #1 weapons, munitions, and war-themed fashion accessory manufacturer in the Greater Badlands area!

BLU? RED? As long as your money's green, I WILL sell you items you can use to MAKE THEM PAY! And ancillary items you can wear, so you'll look CLASSY AS ALL HELL doing it! Kill whoever you like. I won't judge you!
loc.store_introtext_winter1: Christmas? Hanukkah? Kwanzaa? Non-Occasional Get-Together at Ayn Rand's House? Whatever you're celebrating this year, we'll be here, open twenty-four hours a day, every day! That's right! We are ready to take your money.  This weekend the Mann Co. Store is having deep discounts on our Polycount Pack items, weapons, hats and more.  Buy them now, before the accountants realize what we're doing!\n\nHurry, because this offer ends soon!
loc.store_introtext_winter2: The Mann Co. Store is having another sale! In honor of the holiday season, for a limited time, the prices on a staggering number of hats are UNREASONABLY LOW!  Why wait until prices are reasonable again?\n\nWe're cleaning out the entire Team Fortress inventory, from H to Ha! Finally, give yourself the hat you always wanted but could never afford (even though it was sensibly priced).
loc.store_introtext_winter3: It's the final sale of the decade, possibly, and that means we're selling all the stuff we were prevented from selling... at LUDICROUS PRICES! That's right – the European Union Paint Sale Treaty of 2001 has finally expired, and the European Union Paint Sale Treaty of 2011 has yet to be ratified.\n\nGrab these items now, before the fat cats in Brussels get wind of it!

loc.tf_questmap_intro_desc: Welcome to the ConTracker, your gateway to the finest Mann Co. Contracts.\n\nMouse over the buttons below to learn more about how to use your ConTracker
loc.tf_questmap_intro_1: The ConTracker display shows nodes that offer various Contracts. Click on a node to see what Contracts it offers. Click \"Activate\" to take on the Contract. You can have one Contract active at a time.
loc.tf_questmap_intro_2: You can make progress on your Contracts in Casual matches. Doing an objective will earn you Contract Points (CP). You must finish a match for your progress to be saved! Once you've completed a Primary or Bonus objective, you can turn-in the Contract to get its rewards.  You can reactivate Contracts you've only partially completed at any time.
loc.tf_questmap_intro_3: Turning in Primary and Bonus objectives earns you items and Stars. Use your Stars to activate more Contracts.\n\nPremium Contracts can also reward Blood Money, which can be spent in the Mercenary Park Gift Shop.

loc.tf_weapon_flamethrower_desc: Afterburn reduces Medi Gun healing and resist shield effects.\nAlt-Fire: Release a blast of air that pushes enemies and projectiles and extinguishes teammates that are on fire.
loc.tf_weapon_knife_desc: Attack an enemy from behind to Backstab them for a one hit kill.
loc.tf_weapon_wrench_desc: Upgrades, repairs and speeds up construction of friendly buildings on hit
loc.tf_weapon_spy_sapper_desc: Place on enemy buildings to disable and slowly drain away its health.  Placing a sapper does not remove your disguise
loc.tf_weapon_watch_desc: Alt-Fire: Turn invisible.  Cannot attack while invisible.  Bumping in to enemies will make you slightly visible to enemies
loc.tf_weapon_cannon_desc: Double Donk! Bomb explosions after a cannon ball impact will deal mini-crits to impact victims
loc.tf_weapon_ap_sap_desc: Mann Co. got a great deal from a nice lady in an abandoned science facility on a warehouse full of slightly used, possibly mildly defective sappers. Unlike our other sappers, the Ap-Sap is sentient, and will provide hours of lively, one-sided conversation while you're trying to work.
loc.tf_weapon_hothand_desc: This melee slap tells your opponent, and anyone watching the kill feed, that your hand just gave some lucky face the gift of slapping it stupid.
loc.tf_weapon_dragonsfury_desc: This powerful, single-shot flamethrower rewards consecutive hits with faster reloads and bonus damage.
loc.tf_weapon_dragonsfury_neutraldesc:
Uses a shared pressure tank for Primary Fire and Alt-Fire.

Primary Fire: Launches a fast-moving projectile that briefly ignites enemies

Alt-Fire: Release a blast of air that pushes enemies and projectiles, and extinguishes teammates that are on fire.
loc.tf_weapon_dragonsfury_positivedesc: Deals 300% damage to burning players\n+50% repressurization rate on hit
loc.tf_weapon_rocketlauncher_jump_desc: A special rocket launcher for learning\nrocket jump tricks and patterns.\nThis weapon deals ZERO damage.
loc.tf_weapon_stickybomb_jump_desc: A special no-damage stickybomb launcher for learning stickybomb jump tricks and patterns.

Press and hold the Actionkey
to quickly fire a grapple line.

Optionally can be switched to by pressing slot6
and manually fired using primary attack.

Can only be used in Mannpower Mode or when enabled by the server.
loc.tf_weapon_flaregun_detonator_desc: Alt-Fire: Detonate flare.\nThis weapon will reload automatically when not active.
loc.tf_weapon_breadbite_desc: Inspired by the TF2 Movie 'Expiration Date'
loc.tf_weapon_snackattack_desc: Inspired by the TF2 Movie 'Expiration Date'
loc.tf_weapon_mutatedmilk_desc: Players heal 60% of the damage done to an enemy covered with milk.\n\nInspired by the TF2 Movie 'Expiration Date'
loc.tf_weapon_basejumper_desc: Press 'JUMP' key in the air to deploy.\nDeployed Parachutes slow your descent.
